CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   C. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
